summary: BTQ Technologies Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald Co. and Cantor Fitzgerald Canada Corporation. The agreement allows the company to sell up to C$150,000,000 of its common shares from time to time through the agents. This is a standard at-the-market (ATM) equity distribution facility, not a special situation. The shares will be offered under a Canadian base shelf prospectus and a corresponding U.S. Registration Statement declared effective September 2025. There are no deal terms related to mergers, acquisitions, or restructuring; the filing pertains to routine capital-raising activities.
